title: NTT Data in final talks to build Anthropic's first Japan data center
summary: NTT Data is in final talks to build a 500MW, up to ¥1T ($6.3B) data center in Osaka for Anthropic, with partial operations targeted for 2028.
reason: Compute expansion in Japan; deal not yet signed.

title: IMF flags AI share crash as a top threat to global financial stability
summary: The IMF's Global Financial Stability Report named an AI equity correction as one of three top risks, noting heavy non-US exposure to US AI assets.
reason: Warning that AI gains are concentrated and fragile; signal. Original outlet (The Guardian/IMF GFSR) cited via aggregator; direct link not captured.
